newsitem.title: UK: BT to spend 50 mln stg on Internet terminals.
newsitem.headline: BT to spend 50 mln stg on Internet terminals.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc, the United Kingdom's dominant telecoms company, is set to invest 50 million stg in building the biggest network of touch-screen terminals for accessing the Internet in Europe, said the Financial Times on Tuesday.
The report said the so-called "Touchpoint" terminals will allow users to book flights, cinema tickets and order consumer goods. Users could also display maps and news on screen.
Up to 10,000 screens will be available in public locations, including hotels and shopping centres. The move is part of an effort to diversify revenues, said the FT report.
Apart from a small fee for use of the terminal, BT is expected to earn most of the revenue generated by the service from goods sold through the network and advertising on it.
